import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    ans = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(s):
        current = s[i]
        j = i + 1
        while j < len(s) and s[j] == current:
            j += 1
        length = j - i
        if length % 2 == 0:
            ans += 1
        i = j
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
